fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that a payment wallet of the complainant was accessed from an unfamiliar device and Rs. 12,000 was moved to another account. The matter was brought to Vellore North PS on 2025-08-26, while the incident was placed on 2025-08-26 at about 14:00. The complainant, Deviga Murugan, provided the contact number 9000000058. The complaint mentions Vignesh Subramani, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000487, in connection with the events. The account reference SYN-ACC-100076 was noted in connection with the payment. Ramesh Pandian (9000000469) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant mentioned a bank transaction reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00041, as the mobile number 9000000487 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: OTP allegedly obtained during a call before the account was accessed.
fields.Keywords: account takeover, unauthorised access, mobile number, witness, receiving account, afternoon, bank reference, main street
